title: Bill Gates, “The next outbreak? We're not ready”
listen_for: Calm, flat delivery with strong contrasts: not missiles, but microbes · this vs this with pointing intonation · weak forms: filled with cans of food and water.

cues.t: When I was a kid, / the disaster we worried about most / was a nuclear war.
That's why we had a barrel like this down in our basement,
When the nuclear attack came, / we were supposed to go downstairs, / hunker down, / and eat out of that barrel.
Today the greatest risk of global catastrophe / doesn't look like this.
If anything kills over 10 million people / in the next few decades,
it's most likely to be a highly infectious virus / rather than a war.
Now, part of the reason for this is that / we've invested a huge amount in nuclear deterrence.
But we've actually invested very little / in a system to stop an epidemic.
We're not ready for the next epidemic.
I'm sure all of you read about it in the newspaper, / lots of tough challenges.
